title: Code review report: INFRA-1 (bootstrap CloudFormation and runbook), INFRA-2 (CI, dependency check, Dependabot), INFRA-3 (app readiness for AWS)
summary: Round 1 for 5fe6834, d676c4c and 322808d: REQUEST CHANGES, with 1 blocker, 4 majors and 8 minors. INFRA-1 and INFRA-2 are sound apart from minors: the OIDC trust requires aud sts.amazonaws.com, the terraform role is an exact sub match on one workflow file on main per account, fork pull requests get no token, the state bucket is private, versioned, encrypted, TLS-only and retained, cfn-lint 1.60.0 is clean, the workflows use contents: read, persist-credentials false, no pull_request_target, no secrets and no untrusted expressions in run steps, and all four action SHAs match their tags. BLOCKER: app.cli db-roles cannot run as the RDS master, which is not a superuser. ALTER SCHEMA public OWNER TO jobproof_migrator fails because the migrator lacks CREATE on the database, and on any later run ALTER ROLE ... NOSUPERUSER NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS is refused by PG16. Both were reproduced on PostgreSQL 16.15 as a non-superuser CREATEROLE role in a rolled-back transaction. The B11 tests run ensure_roles as the superuser, so they missed it. Majors: that test gap; role passwords sent in clear in SQL text, so the failing ALTER writes them to the RDS log, which the plan role (any pull request) can download through ReadOnlyAccess rds:Download*; and the RDS CA bundle is still the placeholder (fail-closed is correct, but no deploy can start). The grants themselves are right. Full test suites not re-run by the reviewer; reported at HEAD: backend 1746, shared 439, web 279, e2e 149, all green.

NOSUPERUSER ... NOREPLICATION NOBYPASSRLS fails for a non-superuser. Reproduced on PG 16.15. Owner: backend

blocks.heading: What the reviewer found sound
items: OIDC trust: aud sts.amazonaws.com; exact sub match per terraform role; plan role wildcard cannot get past the repo prefix; fork PRs get no token.
State bucket: versioned, encrypted, public access blocked, TLS-only, retained; London-only rule; cfn-lint clean.
Workflows: minimal permissions, persist-credentials false, no pull_request_target, no secrets, no untrusted expressions in run steps; action SHAs match their tags.
Grants: no TRUNCATE; audit_events SELECT/INSERT only; app role owns nothing; drift revoked; server-side quoting prevents SQL injection.
Demo seed guards, create-user, /health/live, upload-web.sh and smoke-test.sh behave as specified.

blocks.heading: Questions for the architect
items: Is the real RDS CA bundle an INFRA-3 merge condition or the INFRA-6 entry gate? (Decision: INFRA-6 entry gate, tracked.)
Confirm 'no secret in Terraform state' as a hard INFRA-4 requirement.
Who owns fixes in .github/ and infra/bootstrap? (Decision: the infra engineer.)
